title: Add a pagination feature to a Go HTTP handler
description: A Go HTTP handler returns all items but doesn't support pagination. Add ?page=N&limit=N query param support.

task_spec.prompt:
Add pagination support to the ListItems handler in handler.go.

Read the query params `page` (default 1) and `limit` (default 0 = all). When limit > 0:
- Compute offset = (page - 1) * limit
- Return items[offset : offset+limit] (handle out-of-bounds gracefully by returning up to the end)

When no limit is given (limit=0 or missing), return all items as before.

Run `go test ./...` to verify all 4 tests pass.
success_criteria: page and limit query params supported
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `go test ./...` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
